nodes.label: iOS blank launch image placeholder
nodes.rationale: 68-byte transparent 1x1 placeholder images from the Flutter template; iOS launch screen not customized.

nodes.label: Default Flutter app icon
nodes.rationale: Android mipmaps, iOS AppIcon set and macOS AppIcon set still carry the stock Flutter logo (light/dark blue chevron 'F' on white; macOS variant is a rounded-square tile with drop shadow). Native platform icons have not been rebranded to the coffee shop identity.

nodes.label: Quan Nha coffee brand logo
nodes.rationale: Custom circular badge: hand-drawn house with a steaming coffee cup on the roof, coffee leaves, text 'QUAN NHA' and tagline 'CA PHE - GIA DINH' (home-style family coffee) with a coffee bean; warm brown/orange/cream palette. Used only for the web favicon and PWA icons (maskable variants padded on a cream background).

nodes.label: list_prepend
nodes.rationale: Helper because CMake 3.10 lacks list(TRANSFORM ... PREPEND)

nodes.label: Analyzer Exclude Platform Dirs
nodes.rationale: Excludes build and generated platform folders (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux) so lints only apply to Dart app code
